# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Quick Consult Credit

**Purpose**: Pre-`/speckit-tasks` reviewer gate validating requirements quality across API & Integration, Security, Data Integrity & Concurrency, Performance & Scale, Admin/Customer UX, and Purchase & Redemption Flows.
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API & Integration Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Is the exact set of permitted `transaction_type` values for external callers enumerated in one authoritative place, and does that enumeration match the wording of the rejection rule for other types? [Consistency, Spec §api.md QCC-API-016]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the required vs. optional request fields for transaction-creation explicitly and exhaustively listed, rather than described as "at minimum"? [Clarity, Spec §api.md QCC-API-008/009]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the response schema for a successful transaction-creation request fully enumerated, or does "at minimum" (QCC-API-014) leave room for inconsistent field sets across implementations? [Ambiguity, Spec §api.md QCC-API-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the specific HTTP status codes for each named error (`CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`, `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`, `INVALID_AMOUNT`, unauthorized) specified consistently, rather than only implied by a parenthetical example ("e.g., HTTP 400")? [Clarity, Spec §api.md QCC-API-015/019]
- [ ] CHK005 Is duplicate-request behavior defined for deployments where the idempotency-key requirement (QCC-API-013) is configured off, or only for the default (required) configuration? [Gap, Spec §api.md QCC-API-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are rate-limiting requirements for the transaction-creation endpoint specified anywhere, beyond QCC-API-018's general "retry-safe" concurrency requirement? [Gap, Spec §api.md QCC-API-018]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification define behavior when `reference_type`/`reference` is omitted but is implicitly necessary for a specific transaction type (e.g., `REDEEM` without a consultation reference)? [Gap, Spec §api.md QCC-API-009]

## Security & Authorization Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK008 Is "least privilege" (QCC-SEC-003) defined with a concrete, testable ACL-resource-to-operation mapping, or only illustrated by a single example? [Measurability, Spec §security.md QCC-SEC-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the specific data categories considered "secrets" (QCC-SEC-006) enumerated, or left to interpretation via "equivalent secrets"? [Clarity, Spec §security.md QCC-SEC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the authorization-before-existence-check ordering stated consistently across every specification that defines its own error precedence, with no contradictory ordering anywhere? [Consistency, Spec §security.md QCC-SEC-008; api.md QCC-API-005/007; redemption.md QCC-REDEEM-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification define "unauthorized" for the balance-retrieval endpoint when the requester is a different authenticated customer (not merely unauthenticated)? [Coverage, Spec §api.md QCC-API-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Are audit/logging requirements defined for authorization *denials* (not only successful admin actions), so a denied attempt is itself traceable? [Gap]

## Data Integrity & Concurrency Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Is the row-locking "synchronization point" requirement (QCC-CONC-001/005) paired with a specified lock-timeout or deadlock-handling behavior, or left undefined? [Gap, Spec §idempotency-concurrency.md QCC-CONC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the specification define the caller-visible response when a concurrent-lock timeout or deadlock occurs, distinct from a normal business rejection? [Gap, Spec §idempotency-concurrency.md QCC-CONC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Is AMB-006 (conflicting-payload idempotency-key replay) still open, and does any downstream requirement implicitly assume a resolution that has not actually been decided? [Ambiguity, Spec §ambiguity-register.md AMB-006; api.md QCC-API-017]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the "cumulative statistic" fields (`total_credited`, `total_debited`) requirements consistent between the account and ledger specifications regarding which is authoritative? [Consistency, Spec §account.md QCC-ACCOUNT-008/009; ledger.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the compensating-transaction correction mechanism (QCC-LEDGER-009) specified with enough detail (e.g., required fields on a compensating entry) to be objectively verified, or only described conceptually? [Measurability, Spec §ledger.md QCC-LEDGER-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the specification define what happens if the purchase-posting unique-reference constraint (QCC-IDEMP-001/QCC-PURCHASE-009) is violated by a legitimate race rather than a true duplicate event? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Performance & Scale Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Are the "nominal load" conditions underlying QCC-PERF-001–004 quantified (e.g., concurrent users, request rate), or is "nominal load" itself an unquantified term? [Ambiguity, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-PERF-001–004]
- [ ] CHK020 Is history page size (QCC-PERF-006 / QCC-CUSTOMER-005) requirement clear about configuration scope (global/website/store), or ambiguous between "default" and "project standard"? [Clarity, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-PERF-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Are degradation requirements defined for load conditions that exceed the approved performance targets? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-PERF-001–004]
- [ ] CHK022 Can "correctness... regardless of throughput" (QCC-PERF-005) be objectively tested without an implied throughput ceiling, or does it require one to be meaningful? [Measurability, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-PERF-005]

## Admin & Customer UX Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK023 Are the exact rejection conditions for admin add/remove (non-positive amount, amount exceeding balance, missing reason) specified with the same rigor as the API error contract? [Consistency, Spec §admin.md QCC-ADMIN-004/005/007/008]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the optional reference identifier's format/length constraint specified for admin add/remove operations? [Gap, Spec §admin.md QCC-ADMIN-003/006]
- [ ] CHK025 Are empty-state (zero transactions) requirements defined for the customer dashboard history table? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §customer-dashboard.md QCC-CUSTOMER-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the customer dashboard's pagination control behavior specified (e.g., navigation affordance), or only the underlying requirement to paginate? [Gap, Spec §customer-dashboard.md QCC-CUSTOMER-005]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the Admin view's display requirements consistent with the Customer dashboard's display requirements in terms of which fields are shown, avoiding a merchant-vs-customer data-parity gap? [Consistency, Spec §admin.md QCC-ADMIN-001/002; customer-dashboard.md QCC-CUSTOMER-002-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the specification define what an administrator sees when a target customer has no credit account yet, parallel to the read-API zero-balance rule? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §account.md QCC-ACCOUNT-004; admin.md]

## Purchase & Redemption Flow Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK029 Is the qualifying-condition rule (invoice generated AND status complete/processing) unambiguous for multi-item orders where only some items are Quick Consult Credit products? [Ambiguity, Spec §purchase.md QCC-PURCHASE-001/004]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the purchase reference (order item identifier) explicitly guaranteed unique and stable across order edits/reorders, or is this an unstated assumption? [Assumption, Spec §purchase.md QCC-PURCHASE-007]
- [ ] CHK031 Are redemption and API requirements consistent about which error takes precedence when both invalid-amount and insufficient-balance conditions could apply to the same request? [Consistency, Spec §redemption.md QCC-REDEEM-008/009; api.md QCC-API-011/015]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the specification define behavior for a partial refund or order cancellation occurring *after* a `PURCHASE` has already been posted, distinct from the explicit exclusion of automated reversal? [Coverage, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-SCOPE-002; purchase.md]
- [ ] CHK033 Is administrator-initiated redemption (redemption.md Actors) clearly reconciled with the external-caller restriction to `REDEEM` only, i.e., is it unambiguous whether an admin invokes `REDEEM` via the same endpoint or only via `ADMIN_REMOVE`? [Ambiguity, Spec §redemption.md Actors; api.md QCC-API-016]

## Traceability & Scope Consistency

- [ ] CHK034 Are all five still-open ambiguity-register items (AMB-001, AMB-002, AMB-006, AMB-009, AMB-010) referenced from every requirement they affect, so a reviewer can find them without searching the whole register? [Traceability, Spec §ambiguity-register.md]
- [ ] CHK035 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme consistently applied across all domain specification files, enabling unambiguous cross-referencing? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK036 Are all 20 acceptance scenarios in QCC-TEST-008 each traceable to a specific requirement ID within their owning domain file, with none left only narratively described? [Traceability, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-TEST-008]
- [ ] CHK037 Do any of the nine out-of-scope items (QCC-SCOPE-001–009) appear elsewhere in the specification set as an implied or de facto requirement (scope-creep check)? [Consistency, Spec §non-functional.md QCC-SCOPE-001–009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`; this file is independent of that one.
- CHK015, CHK029, CHK033 surface pre-existing open items (AMB-006 and two newly identified ambiguities not yet in the register); consider adding the latter two to [ambiguity-register.md](../ambiguity-register.md) if confirmed as genuine gaps during review.
